Available in multiple variants, including linear, tactile, and clicky options, this set caters to every user preference, from ultra-responsive keypresses to satisfying tactile feedback. rawProduct.name: Keychron B6 Pro Ultra-Slim 100% Wireless Keyboard – Ivory White
rawProduct.description:
The Keychron B6 Pro Ultra-Slim 100% Wireless Keyboard is a sleek, full-size keyboard designed to deliver high performance and versatility in a lightweight and ultra-thin package. It supports 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth, and wired modes, allowing seamless connectivity with phones, tablets, PCs, and Macs. ZMK customisation enables users to tailor settings for home, office, or on the go, offering a truly personalised experience across multiple devices. Its ultra-slim body and lightweight design strike a balance between portability and functionality, making it an excellent choice for users who need mobility and productivity.

The B6 Pro’s battery life is one of its standout features, offering up to 1200 hours of continuous use, which is about 8 months with 5 hours of daily typing. This extended battery performance ensures long-term reliability, and the keyboard can even be used while charging, allowing uninterrupted productivity. The 2.4 GHz wireless connection delivers a responsive 1000 Hz polling rate, ideal for a clutter-free setup, while Bluetooth 5.2 makes switching between devices fast and effortless. Whether for work or leisure, the B6 Pro provides a smooth, high-performance wireless experience that enhances multitasking across different devices.

Designed with both Mac and Windows users in mind, the B6 Pro maintains a Mac layout while offering full compatibility with Windows, providing the same multimedia and function key support found in Apple keyboards but with improved tactile feedback. The concave keycaps ensure precise typing, reducing errors and improving comfort during long sessions. With features like emoji shortcuts, customisable keymaps through the Keychron Launcher, and a protective silicone key skin, the B6 Pro is a versatile, user-friendly keyboard that offers a premium typing experience with enhanced protection against spills and wear.

  • Ultra-slim and lightweight design
  • Scissor mechanism for switches
